prompt: A worker’s last two readings match, but they can see water flowing onto the road. What should the worker do?
promptZh: 一名工作人員的最後兩次讀值相同，但看到有水流到路面。應該怎麼做？

options.text: Enter the matching result and call the duty officer immediately.
options.zh: 填入相同的讀值，並立即打電話給值班主管。
options.whyZh: 最後兩次讀值相同即可填數字，但路面有流水仍須立即通報，電話不能代替紀錄。

options.text: Enter the matching result and leave the matter for the dawn review.
options.zh: 填入相同的讀值，等清晨審查處理。
options.whyZh: 路面有流水時不能等清晨，必須立刻打電話。

options.text: Call the duty officer immediately and omit the log entry.
options.zh: 立即打電話給值班主管，不用填紀錄。
options.whyZh: 立刻通報沒錯，但打電話不能取代紀錄。

options.text: Write “unsettled” and wait to see whether another reading matches.
options.zh: 填「未穩定」，再等下一次讀值是否相符。
options.whyZh: 兩次既已相同就不應填「未穩定」，且路面流水必須立即通報。

explanationZh: 最後兩次讀值相同即可填數字，但路面有流水仍須立即通報，電話不能代替紀錄。
evidence: Use the last two readings, and enter a result only if they match. / If water is visibly running onto the road, call the duty officer right away regardless of the meter result. / This call is in addition to the log entry, not in place of it.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Use the last two readings, and enter a result only if they match.
If water is visibly running onto the road, call the duty officer right away regardless of the meter result.
This call is in addition to the log entry, not in place of it.

vocabulary.note: 通話和填寫紀錄都要做，不可互相代替。
